title: Austin's Financial Shortfall: Next Steps
summary:
*   City leaders held a strategic retreat to discuss the budget, work plan, and upcoming special projects.
*   A primary focus was addressing an existing "General Fund Shortfall," signaling the city faced a budget deficit.
*   Council directed staff to prepare an action plan and budget amendments for an upcoming meeting to tackle this financial challenge.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - May 30, 1987 - 8:30 A.M. TO 3:45 P.M.
HILLS FITNESS CENTER, 4611 WEST BEE CAVES ROAD Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street,
Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council,
noting the absence of Councilmember Humphrey and Mayor Pro Tern Trevino. Mayor Cooksey
announced the special called meeting was a Council retreat. On the agenda was budget
discussion, workplan and special projects.
Council directed the posting of an addendum to the June 2, 1987 agenda to consider
approval of a strategy and associated budget amendments to meet the current year General
Fund Shortfall.
Council took no action on a resolution to consider appointments of Councilmembers to the
Policy Planning and Budget Committee and the Audit Committee.
Council adjourned its meeting at 3:45 p.m.
